rows.en: Haha, don't get so mad, Princess Alto.
Grr, Michael, you bastard!
(Alto and Michel got into another fight, huh...)

(Those two are always fighting,
but how long have they known each other?)
Alto, got a sec?
What is it, \p?

You and Michel get along great, Alto.
How long have you two known each other?

Get along?
Well, now I know your eyes are just for show...

Let's see...
I met Michael right before we graduated junior high.

Somebody from the Pilot Course wrecked one of
Nanase's paintings, so I tried to make them apologize.

And that's when I met Michael...
Come to think of it, I never did get him
to apologize for that.

Hey, Michael!
About that time back then...!
Huh? Oh, wait...

(I went and dug up an old feud...
Sorry, Michel!)

(Saotome-kun and Michel-kun got into another fight,
huh...)

(Those two are always fighting,
but how long have they known each other?)
Saotome-kun, got a sec?

You and Michel-kun get along great, Saotome-kun.
How long have you two known each other?

(I went and dug up an old feud...
Sorry, Michel-kun!)

(Okay, time to give it my all again today...
Hm, Alto and Luca? ...Something feels off...)
You'd never understand, Alto-senpai! Never!
Like you'd understand how I feel!

Nope! The stubborn one here is definitely you,
Alto-senpai!
Now, now, calm down, both of you...

Oh, \p...
Hey, hear me out for a sec...

Alto-senpai is being so mean! He said, "Lucky you,
Luca. You're younger than me and skipped a grade,
and your grades are still perfect..." and stuff...
Hey, it's the truth!

There are things even I can't do, no matter how hard
I try! My flying is nowhere near as good as
yours or Michel-senpai's, Alto-senpai...

Give it another year and you'll fly just like us!
You're only getting started!
There's no guarantee of that anywhere!
Then I'll guarantee it!

Huh...!?
Senpai...
Thank you so much!
(Well, it all worked out okay... I guess...)

(Okay, time to do my best again today...
Hm, Saotome-kun and Luca-kun? ...Something feels off...)
Come on, now, calm down, both of you...
(Well, it all worked out okay... I guess...?)

(Okay, what's my next class...
Huh? Alto and Ranka...?)
Alto-kun, please!

What are you thinking?
There's no way I could do that!

Sure you can, Alto-kun!
I just know the customers would love it, too!

Quit messing around!
What would I even get out of doing that...
Just go do it yourself!
Wha... You don't have to put it like that...
Come on, Alto, there's no need to get that mad...

Oh, \p-kun!
You tell him too, \p-kun!
Huh? Tell him what?

Nyan-Nyan's holding a Uniform Beauty Contest soon,
and I just know Alto-kun would win if he entered!
So...
Don't "So..." me!
(Those two get along great, I bet...)

(Okay, what's my next class...
Huh? Saotome-kun and Ranka-chan...?)
Come on, Saotome-kun, there's no need to get that mad...

Oh, \p-chan!
You tell him too, \p-chan!
(Those two get along great, I bet...)

(Well, that's it for today's classes...
Huh, it's Alto and Michel... Another fight?)
I won't budge on this one. It's definitely you!

Wha-!?
No way! It's obviously you!

No, no,
my name's not nearly as well known as yours!
What on earth's going on? Why all the shouting...?

Oh, \p.
Well, see, we were arguing over which of us
will get more chocolate this Valentine's...

Obviously it's gonna be this womanizer, right!?
I'm not even all that...

Hmm... You sure about that...?
I know all about the presents from guys
that keep piling up in your locker...

Wha-!? Th-those don't count!
Besides, I toss that stuff the second I get it!

Oh-ho, so you admit you get them from guys,
our gorgeous former female-role actor,
"Prin-cess Al-to."
Miii-chaaa-el!!

(Both of them just take it for granted they'll get
tons of chocolate... And they admit it about
each other. That's impressive...)

(Well, that's it for today's classes...
Huh, it's Saotome-kun and Michel-kun... Another fight?)
What on earth's going on? Why all the shouting...?

Oh, \p-chan.
Well, see, we were arguing over which of us
will get more chocolate this Valentine's...

(Both of them just take it for granted they'll get
tons of chocolate... They really do acknowledge
each other.)

uncertain: c15866: the student from the Pilot Course who ruined Nanase's painting is unnamed; kept gender-neutral ("Somebody ... them"). c15867 reads that Alto still wants Michael to apologize (next line he shouts at Michael about it).
c15902: seifuku bijin kontesuto rendered "Uniform Beauty Contest" (not in glossary; an in-world Nyan-Nyan event).
c15918: "a-ru-to-hi-me" spelled out syllable by syllable rendered "Prin-cess Al-to"; moto bijin oyama = "our gorgeous former female-role actor" (kabuki onnagata, as in earlier finished lines).
c15904/c15908: also used in nml_she_019/020 (Alto and Sheryl); wording fits both scenes.
